The y-axis shows In real life using scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 0.6 while the x-axis measures Response with categorical scale starting at Balance and ending at Transfer between accounts.
caption_L2L3: Whilst people in Denmark use these devices to send and receive money, it is only being used for international transfers. Millennials tend to use these devices most to withdraw money. They are popular for car and property loans.
